mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prohibited_word (WORD, CATEGORY, ACTIVE, REASON, VERSION) VALUES (#{word}, #{category}, #{active}, #{reason}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ, WORD, CATEGORY, ACTIVE, REASON, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, VERSION FROM prohibited_word ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE prohibited_word SET VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE SEQ = #{seq}
mapper.select: SELECT SEQ, WORD, CATEGORY, ACTIVE, REASON, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, VERSION FROM prohibited_word WHERE ACTIVE = TRUE ORDER BY SEQ
